scope: Fresh detached local clone and absent-preference synthetic single-file exports on both Windows hosts.

Clone objects come from the maintained local Git repository at the parent-verified pushed revision.
Explicit output and an absent SettingsPath under isolated APPDATA avoid user Music and preferences.
Mode Raw and dependency/output/absent-settings paths are explicit; preset, loudness mode, encoding and cleaning are built-ins.
No manual Explorer drop, interview recording, UI gesture, listening or default-sound promotion is claimed.

M3-06.title: Workflow and automation gate
M3-06.scope: End-to-end local workflow review and thread checkpoint.
implementation: Exercise the original single-file workflow alongside multi-file, folder, preview and noninteractive flows.
Run cumulative targeted tests once, focusing on launcher boundaries, cancellation and configuration migration.
Document remaining platform constraints, push the checkpoint and update the exact next task.
M3-06.guardrails: No unrelated refactor, default-sound change, or publication.

acceptance.title: Original workflow
acceptance.procedure: Drop a typical interview file, select 1/2 and inspect the result/report.
acceptance.expected: Same simple front-door experience remains; new settings do not overwhelm the default menu.

acceptance.title: Automation workflow
acceptance.procedure: Invoke unattended batch with explicit parameters and examine process codes/files/reports.
acceptance.expected: No prompt, missing file, misleading aggregate result or timing change.

acceptance.title: Reentry workflow
acceptance.procedure: Restart in a new thread or clean checkout with recorded settings intentionally absent.
acceptance.expected: Built-in defaults suffice; state and remaining tasks are recovered from Git, not hidden machine settings.

appdata_observation: APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA were isolated, but both actual .NET ApplicationData known-folder reads retained the OS profile location. An explicit absent SettingsPath within the isolated APPDATA directory was supplied for both actual applications, so no personal configuration was read and no preferences were created. This does not claim environment variables redirected the OS known folder.
